trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Remark, five paragraphs, read in full. All ten categories clean. The opening 'The surface supplies the genus-4 handles. The Reeb vector supplies the flow through them. The substrate parameter q sets the flow's pitch.' is a parallel three-sentence run, but the three assignments are distinct and substantive (topology / dynamics / parameter), so it is not a reflex triple. The closing two-limit paragraph looked like a placed symmetric closer, and I checked it before ruling: its q -> infinity half carries information found nowhere else in the block ([X,P]_q -> J, spinning maximal), so the paragraph is load-bearing rather than a restatement, even though its q -> 1 half does overlap paragraph 2. No em-dashes, no warmth, no meta-commentary, no superlatives. CONSISTENCY CHECK: the q -> 1 limit statements agree with the framework -- hbar_q = 1 - q^{-1} -> 0 as q -> 1, so '[X,P]_q -> 0' and 'the Reeb field trivialises' are the right direction, and hbar_q -> 1 as q -> infinity matches '[X,P]_q -> J' with J a finite maximum.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: TWO SYMBOL FINDINGS, neither fixed (both are notation-register matters). (1) UNDEFINED SYMBOL: J appears only in the final sentence, '[X,P]_q -> J', with no definition anywhere in the block and no uses[] entry that obviously supplies it. Since the same sentence is the block's only statement about the large-q regime, the reader cannot evaluate it. (2) POSSIBLE zeta COLLISION. This block says 'The C_5 phase rotation now circulates around the exceptional divisor' and twice writes the phase rotation as w_k -> zeta^k w_k. The sibling prop:ramified-disc-fusion, which shares the same w_k resolvents and the same chapter, derives w_k -> zeta^{-k} w_k with zeta a CUBE root of unity coming from the three colour coordinates (c_r, c_g, c_b). C_5 is natural for Bring's surface and a cube root is natural for the colour triple, but one glyph zeta is doing both jobs across two adjacent blocks with no disambiguation. Per the notation-collision register this needs either two symbols or an explicit statement of which root of unity is meant where.
